modules.module_title: Perform maintenance of measuring and control equipment

pcs.pc_description: check from “Technician Instrumentation” that the measuring device is functioning within tolerance limits or not
re-fix or re-position the measuring device until reading comes to the satisfying range, in case of errors in reading
connect the linking device so that no transmission errors take place due to intermediate losses / interference
perform basic health check-up of measuring and control equipment as specified in the maintenance checklist
execute suitable re-routing of transmission system if need to achieve satisfactory results
check the equipment parts for any wear and tear, damage, improper functioning etc.
repair or replace damaged components as per the requirement
re-connect or return the system after completion of maintenance activities
report any instances where the maintenance activities cannot be fully met or where there are identified defects outside the planned schedule
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
re-position the pick-up / sensor to better location as advised by “Technician Instrumentation”
re-fix the pick-up / sensor with better fixing device / fastener as advised by “Technician Instrumentation”
monitor the problem and keep the superior informed about progress or any delays in resolving the problem
refer the problem to “Technician Instrumentation” or competent internal / external specialist if it cannot be resolved

modules.module_title: Testing of measuring and control equipment

pcs.pc_description: identify the testing and calibration requirements by following standard operating procedures
prepare and update testing/calibration schedules and plans as per the WI
select the appropriate test equipment in accordance with defined requirements
select the correct test applications for testing of measuring and control equipment
check the components, leads, fasteners, etc. for any damage, wear and tear, loose connections and other faults

carry out testing of the measuring and control equipment i.e. sensors, transmitters, converters, indicators, analyzers, controllers, power supplies, circuit boards etc. to diagnose faults by using testing devices
apply appropriate testing procedures for assessing the operation of measuring and control equipment
record observations/ readings as per the parameters mentioned in the testing manual/Work Instructions
analyze the test results against specified operational specifications and localized faults and report to the supervisor about the potential faults identified
suggest and implement corrective actions to rectify the issues identified as per SOP
monitor and review the effectiveness of corrective actions planned for fault rectification and prepare reports for the regulatory authorities on the same
assess the calibration of measuring and control equipment w.r.t manufacturers' specifications and/or standard operating procedures
carry out calibration of each measuring and control equipment against appropriate physical standards by using correct calibration devices, equipment, techniques and predetermined procedures
check zero error, span and range of the equipment on indicators/controllers by using correct and appropriate configuration
prepare and update documents and records related to testing/calibration activities done
carry out recommissioning of equipment in accordance with standard operating procedures
report any instances where the testing/calibration activities cannot be fully met
